radiculopathy is an lower motor neuron lesion\u0026nbsp; here acute lesion is due to disc prolapse where as gradual condition is due to osteophytes.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;cervical myelopathy is an upper motor neuron lesion.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETaking insulin injection and doing exercise cause HYPOGLYCEMIA due to increased blood flow by which insulin absorption is increased.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E13\/05\/2020\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERenal tubular acidosis- Type 1:\u0026nbsp; DCT is involved and inability to excrete acid into urine is present.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EType 2:PCT is involved and bicarbonate is excreted in excess in this type.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EType 4:In this deficiency or inability to respond to aldosterone is the main pathology and has persisting hyperkalemia.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EType 1 RTA gives rise to nephrocalcinosis and nephrolithiasis due to:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cul\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"topbullet\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatients have a constant release of calcium phosphate from bones to buffer the extracellular H\u003Csup\u003E+\u003C\/sup\u003E.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"topbullet\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatients have decreased reabsorption of calcium and phosphate, leading to hypercalciuria and hyperphosphaturia.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"topbullet\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatients have relatively alkaline urine, which promotes calcium phosphate precipitation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"topbullet\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMetabolic acidosis and hypokalemia lead to hypocitraturia, a risk factor for stones. Citrate in the urine complexes calcium and inhibits stone formation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E14\/05\/2020\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESacubitril is a new antihypertensive drug which acts by increasing ANP by inhibiting neprilysin(enzyme that degrades ANP).\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIt is usually used in combination with valsartan(ARB) as sacubitril increases angiotensin 2 level.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/hitesh116.blogspot.com\/feeds\/1418777216121559468\/comments\/default","title":"Post
